claims.title: Ordered sums in the integral binomial basis
claims.statement: For positive t_i and T=sum(t_i), the sum over 0<=u_1<...<u_m<b of product u_i^t_i is an integer-valued rational polynomial of degree at most T+m<=2T, hence has integral Newton coefficients.

claims.title: Filtered finite-product approximation
claims.statement: If F(u)=1+sum a_t u^t with a_t in p^t Z_(p), the finite product over u<b has a binomial-polynomial approximation modulo p^c of degree at most 2(c-1). Total-grade truncation preserves this bound for products over arbitrarily many variables; inverse linear-unit products obey it too.

claims.title: Exact factorial factorization into linear units
claims.statement: For P=p^g and 0<=rho<P, gamma=(rho+Pb)!/(rho! b! (P!)^b) equals product_(i<=rho)(1+Pb/i) times product_(ell=1..g,u<b,1<=a<=p^ell,p nondividing a)(1+p^ell u/a). Each nonconstant linear coefficient belongs to p Z_(p), so gamma is a unit.

claims.title: Stronger uniform factorial-unit polynomial theorem
claims.statement: For every prime, finite product Gamma of the digit factorial units and epsilon=+1 or -1, there is an integral binomial polynomial Q of total degree <=2(c-1) approximating Gamma^epsilon modulo p^c uniformly on all natural exponent vectors. It implies DigAbs (4c) and GaAt (6c), keeping downstream constants unchanged.
assumptions: c>=1; c=0 is handled by Q=0.

claims.title: Exact digit Fock identity and diagonal operators
claims.statement: Digit blocks are Fock-orthogonal. Within a block alpha!=C_rho betaPl! betaNo! GammaPl GammaNo with the exact source scalar C_rho. Multiplication of exponent coefficients by binom(alpha,m) equals X^m partial^[m].

claims.title: Highest-weight cost of binomial correction
claims.statement: A diagonal binomial polynomial of degree <=d increases a prefix largest highest-weight coordinate by at most d and preserves letter multidegrees. The proof uses the conjugation module of Euler operators and ordinary characteristic-zero highest-weight bounds.
assumptions: Characteristic-zero rational GL representation theory over the fraction field.

claims.title: Normal test with the exact scalar cY
claims.statement: With w^2=p, cY=w^FNo p^D w^(-v_p(nu!)) makes cY e(X^nu) integral for the actual joint normal projector. Correcting by the inverse factorial unit modulo p^c gives NormTest and NoAt with scalar valuation FNo/2+D-v_p(nu!)/2 and highest-weight slack <=4c.
assumptions: The exact joint projector, whose denominator, self-adjointness and nested/disjoint compatibility are proved in IW/PG.

claims.title: Saturated tensor gluing of segment constraints
claims.statement: For disjoint finite coefficient slots and saturated submodules X_j, the intersection of X_j tensor the other full slots equals the tensor product of all X_j. Prefix weight constraints define rational subspaces whose integral intersections are saturated; slicing, homogeneous components and equivariant renaming preserve those bounds.
assumptions: Finite degree truncation and a DVR coefficient ring.

claims.statement: Under MFH, Tied, BlockOK, NormTest, YY(24,60) and the fixed phi-multidegree, the assembled Gram/normal test satisfies MembAt. Saturated gluing, the carry Frobenius identity, physical degree and label estimates prove DecAt, AlgAt, DegAt and LabAt.
